summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by South Bow Corp, a foreign private issuer, furnishing its quarterly earnings materials (MD&A, interim financial statements, and CEO/CFO certifications) for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. It also references the prior spin-off from TC Energy in 2024, which is historical and not the subject of this filing. Consequently, this is a standard periodic report with no special-situation classification.
